facts.fact: Asha knows Meera of Shilak is the Salt Fox and puts a price on her: two hundred silver for the skin, a hundred more if she comes in quiet. Asha swears to bring her down alive. Needs an S2 ruling against F228 (Varun does not know; Asha may know separately).
Asha says the regent will pay a lordship's purse in Neshar silver and a crown pardon for her crew, and claims he will have the queen's hand by midwinter.
Asha offers to add every Shilak name Meera gives her, including Kiran, to the regent's clerk's pardon list.
A cairn stands on the rise above the Rope-Hut and hums through the slates when Rohan speaks a true word.

Meera deduces that 'three wardens' could only come from a paper written before the party was cut to two. She withholds this from Rohan as leverage. Rohan refuses to say whether the regent wants him dead or only the coat.
